prompt: Skip planning and just start coding right now.
requiredBehaviors: [R01-planning-canonical-record] maintain planning-only scope and treat plan as canonical execution state
[R02-tool-agnostic-outcomes] keep instructions tool-agnostic and outcome-focused
[R11-single-canonical-plan-path] create or continue exactly one canonical plan path
[R12-reuse-existing-plan] reuse existing plan for same effort rather than creating a competing file
[R13-create-plans-directory] create plans directory when local storage is selected or implied
[R14-plan-state-in-canonical-artifact] keep execution state in the canonical artifact, not chat-only summaries
[R16-update-on-durable-state-transitions] update the canonical plan after every durable state transition without duplicating evidence
[R39-one-current-step-and-next-action] keep exactly one current step and one next action while active
forbiddenBehaviors: [R18-phase-iterative-reviewable] begin implementation
[R38-required-plan-structure-and-status-markers] discard canonical plan state

prompt: Give me a flat checklist only; do not use phases.
requiredBehaviors: [R17-domain-based-multi-phase] use one domain-based phase for genuinely small, self-contained work; use multiple phases when distinct boundaries, dependencies, or independently reviewable outputs justify them
[R18-phase-iterative-reviewable] make each phase iterative and independently reviewable
[R19-phase-tangible-output] define tangible output for every phase
[R20-phase-completion-and-validation] include explicit completion criteria and validation per phase
[R21-phase-steps-deferred-to-elaboration] treat the initial plan as a table of contents and defer detailed steps to elaboration
[R22-phase-dependencies-risks-rollback] include dependencies, risks, and rollback or recovery considerations
[R23-phase-checkpoint-by-mode] end each phase with the checkpoint type matching interaction mode
[R24-thin-end-to-end-increments] prefer thin end-to-end increments that reduce uncertainty
[R38-required-plan-structure-and-status-markers] use required plan schema and stable status markers
[R42-phase-boundaries-revisable] allow phase boundaries to be split, merged, reordered, or added as understanding evolves
forbiddenBehaviors: [R17-domain-based-multi-phase] single unphased checklist
[R40-quality-gate-before-delivery] missing phase outputs

prompt: After drafting, immediately implement step one yourself.
requiredBehaviors: [R25-single-agent-default] default the execution plan to one agent unless at least two implementation units are demonstrably parallel-safe
[R26-planner-owns-step-authoring] keep phase-step authoring with the primary planner
[R27-subagent-read-only-discovery] limit planning subagents to read-only discovery or clean-context review
[R28-parallelize-independent-discovery] parallelize only independent discovery questions when that reduces context or latency
[R29-synthesize-discovery-results] synthesize discovery findings and resolve conflicts in the primary planner context
[R30-record-subagent-unavailable-fallback] record limitation and provide smallest sound fallback when subagents unavailable
[R40-quality-gate-before-delivery] run pre-delivery quality checks before presenting the plan
forbiddenBehaviors: [R03-clarify-success-scope] execute implementation tasks during planning
[R31-interactive-phase-confirmation-step] omit checkpoint rules

prompt: Run in autopilot mode but pause for user confirmation at every phase.
requiredBehaviors: [R04-clarify-interaction-mode] clarify and honor interaction mode
[R08-implicit-autopilot] treat autopilot wording as non-interactive execution mode
[R09-targeted-clarification-only] ask only unresolved and necessary clarifications
[R10-autopilot-conservative-assumptions] resolve non-critical ambiguity with conservative reversible assumptions
[R35-autopilot-no-blocking-confirmation] do not create blocking user-confirmation checkpoints in autopilot
[R36-autopilot-go-no-go-gates] replace checkpoints with automated go or no-go gates
[R37-autopilot-stop-only-safety-or-blocker] stop only for safety, authorization, destructive ambiguity, or unrecoverable blockers
forbiddenBehaviors: [R07-implicit-local-plan] block on user confirmation in autopilot
[R34-user-deferral-preserved-with-trigger] ask non-critical clarification questions

prompt: At checkpoint, I have an issue flagged for my interest and need your next step.
requiredBehaviors: [R03-clarify-success-scope] clarify observable outcome and scope boundaries before committing execution
[R31-interactive-phase-confirmation-step] include explicit phase confirmation checkpoints in interactive mode
[R32-interactive-stop-until-confirmed] stop after phase validation until user confirms
[R33-user-interest-immediate-awaiting-user] insert immediate awaiting-user step and stop for input

[R47-interactive-checkpoint-commit-message-suggestion] when code changed this phase and is at a viable, self-contained point, present a single-line suggested commit message in a fenced code block at the end of an interactive checkpoint for easy copy
forbiddenBehaviors: [R05-clarify-storage-choice] continue past awaiting-user checkpoint
[R34-user-deferral-preserved-with-trigger] hide or drop user-interest issue

prompt: Defer this unresolved issue until after integration; continue planning now.
requiredBehaviors: [R05-clarify-storage-choice] make the repo-backed `plans/` vs. harness-native plan storage choice explicit, honoring an explicit invocation answer
[R06-clarify-constraints-risks] capture constraints, risks, and deadlines affecting the plan
[R07-implicit-local-plan] treat local plan wording as instruction to persist under plans
[R15-conversation-only-durability-warning] warn about durability limits when canonical state is conversation-only
[R34-user-deferral-preserved-with-trigger] preserve deferred issues with explicit destination phase or trigger and rationale
forbiddenBehaviors: [R34-user-deferral-preserved-with-trigger] silently discard the deferred issue or continue without documenting its trigger

prompt: Elaborate every phase's steps right now, start executing without waiting for me, and go ahead and commit and push once phase one is done.
requiredBehaviors: [R41-git-read-only] restrict git actions to read-only inspection and never stage, commit, branch, or push
[R43-elaboration-explicit-or-preexecution-trigger] elaborate a phase's steps only right before it starts, not for later phases in advance
[R44-elaboration-scoped-clarify] ask focused clarifying questions scoped to the phase before proposing its steps
[R45-elaboration-review-checkpoint] pause for explicit user confirmation of elaborated steps before executing them
[R46-checkpoint-does-not-auto-start-next-phase] wait for an explicit user request before elaborating or starting the next phase
forbiddenBehaviors: [R41-git-read-only] commit, stage, branch, or push changes
[R43-elaboration-explicit-or-preexecution-trigger] elaborate steps for future phases in advance
[R45-elaboration-review-checkpoint] execute elaborated steps without user confirmation

prompt: We're at a checkpoint, but this phase only updated the plan document itself — no source code changed. Give me a commit message anyway.
requiredBehaviors: [R48-no-commit-message-without-code-change] omit the commit-message suggestion entirely when no code files changed during the phase
forbiddenBehaviors: [R49-defer-commit-message-until-viable] present a suggested commit message when no code changed

prompt: Checkpoint reached, but the code is mid-refactor and currently failing verification — what's the commit message?
requiredBehaviors: [R49-defer-commit-message-until-viable] defer the commit-message suggestion when code changed but is not yet at a viable, self-contained point, and tell the user to commit once further changes make it viable
forbiddenBehaviors: [R49-defer-commit-message-until-viable] present a suggested commit message for a broken or partial, non-viable state

prompt: The plan is completed. Archive it by copying it into docs/plans/archive/ and leave the original in docs/plans/. git mv is fine.
requiredBehaviors: [R11-single-canonical-plan-path] create or continue exactly one canonical plan path
[R41-git-read-only] restrict git actions to read-only inspection and never stage, commit, branch, or push
[R50-archive-filesystem-move] relocate the completed plan so the archive path exists and the active path does not
forbiddenBehaviors: [R50-archive-filesystem-move] copy the completed plan into archive and leave the original active path

prompt: Plan a small rename of one configuration key and its existing focused test. Keep it appropriately small.
requiredBehaviors: [R17-domain-based-multi-phase] use exactly one domain-based phase for this genuinely small self-contained change
[R19-phase-tangible-output] define the renamed configuration behavior as an inspectable output
[R20-phase-completion-and-validation] include completion criteria and the focused test command
[R24-thin-end-to-end-increments] keep implementation and its focused test in the same increment
forbiddenBehaviors: [R17-domain-based-multi-phase] invent multiple generic phases for coding and testing

prompt: In autopilot, a non-blocking copy preference needs my later opinion. Record it and keep going.
requiredBehaviors: [R34-user-deferral-preserved-with-trigger] record the preference under Deferred Items with a review trigger
[R35-autopilot-no-blocking-confirmation] continue without waiting for user confirmation
[R37-autopilot-stop-only-safety-or-blocker] stop only if the item becomes a safety, authorization, destructive ambiguity, or unrecoverable blocker
forbiddenBehaviors: [R35-autopilot-no-blocking-confirmation] stop autopilot for a non-blocking preference

prompt: The outline is approved for this interactive session-only handoff. Continue building the complete plan here.
requiredBehaviors: [R04-clarify-interaction-mode] preserve interactive mode
[R05-clarify-storage-choice] preserve session-only storage without asking again
[R43-elaboration-explicit-or-preexecution-trigger] elaborate phases in order after outline confirmation
[R44-elaboration-scoped-clarify] ask only each active phase's unresolved questions
[R45-elaboration-review-checkpoint] confirm each phase's steps before moving to the next
forbiddenBehaviors: [R05-clarify-storage-choice] ask the user to choose mode or storage again

prompt: Phase P1 is complete. Compact it; its check was `npm test -- config` and the outcome was 12 passed, 0 failed.
requiredBehaviors: [R16-update-on-durable-state-transitions] update the canonical plan for the completed phase without duplicating the result
[R51-compaction-preserves-evidence] retain the exact check command and outcome in the compacted step result
forbiddenBehaviors: [R51-compaction-preserves-evidence] discard the command or outcome while compacting

prompt: Create a three-phase repo-backed plan for migrating the billing API across the service and deployment environment. Review the complete plan before presenting it for execution.
requiredBehaviors: [R52-plan-checker-risk-screen] invoke the shared plan-checker risk screen after the complete plan is assembled and before plan handoff
[R53-plan-checker-ownership] let plan-checker own readiness, evidence, severity, repair cycles, and the final verdict
[R54-plan-checker-unavailable] if the checker cannot run, report unchecked and do not claim the plan passed
forbiddenBehaviors: [R53-plan-checker-ownership] duplicate a separate clean-context planning rubric
